messages:
Ellen R: Heads-up — enterprise POC blocked. Model returned a function_call payload that passes quick eyeball but fails strict schema because theres trailing plaintext: 

Customer parse error: "JSONDecodeError: Extra data"
Response snippet (sanitized):
```
{\"result\": \"{\\\"id\\\":9001,\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}\"} NOTE: checksum 7f3a
```
Demo scheduled in 3 hours. Can we triage asap? :alarm_clock:
Sam (SE): Ack. Which endpoint & stream mode? client uses function_call + json_mode=strict. Any sample request IDs?
Ellen R: They called hosted rw-infer-2.1-medium, streaming=chunked. They only gave the above response; said parse fails immediately on receive.
Priya (Eng): Likely chunk boundary / post-processing footers appended after the JSON envelope. Two quick options: client-side tolerant parse OR runtime sanitizer. Client workaround (quick Python hack):
```
import re
m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", response_text, flags=re.S)
if m: payload = json.loads(m.group(0))
```
This extracts the first balanced-ish blob (not perfect but works for many POCs).
Jordan (SRE): Noted. I see a small burst of 502s + retries for that tenant pool around 2026-09-02T09:12Z — retries may have caused fallback generator path that doesn't honor json_mode. Request IDs: rq_7f11..., rq_7f12...; I'll pull full traces.
NotifyBot: Log summary attached: 502 at 09:12:03, 429 at 09:12:05, retry_count=2, route=fallback-compat
Sam (SE): Can we ship a fast server-side sanitize that truncates anything after the first top-level `}` before delivering the tool payload? Customer prefer server fix.
Priya (Eng): We can add a tenant-scoped feature flag that strips trailing bytes after the first matched top-level JSON object and emits a sanitization audit log. For Dedicated/private we can enable immediately (10-20m). For hosted tenants we need security signoff for altering payloads — estimate ~2h for gated rollout. I can produce an opt-in config in ~25m for this specific enterprise tenant.
Ellen R: That's great. Customer wants credits if demo hits. Legal already asked for SOC2 report; I have link to artifact. Sam, can you coordinate credits & comms?
Sam (SE): Yep. I'll draft communication: 1) apology, 2) temp client regex snippet, 3) enabling opt-in sanitizer for your tenant (ETA 25m), 4) credit offer + SOC2 link. Will ask @Priya to review technical paragraph.
Jordan (SRE): Also recommend we patch retry fallback to preserve json_mode on partial failures. If not careful, retries can route to text-gen handler. I'll open a short ticket and attach traces.
Priya (Eng): Agreed. I'll do sanitizer opt-in + small note in the technical appendix about retry semantics. Will share a minimal patch & CI link once ready.
Ellen R: Assignments: Priya = enable tenant opt-in sanitize; Jordan = traces + fallback ticket; Sam = customer note + credits; I'll follow up with SOC2 doc link. Back with update in ~30m. :thumbsup:
